shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json; cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; cat src/types/ai.ts'
/bin/zsh -lc "cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; rg -n 'specs/.+#|@spec|spec:' src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -35; cat jest.config.js; git status -sb; ls scripts/spec-links"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]|@spec' src scripts | head -40; cat scripts/check-spec-links.mjs | head -100; cat scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs | head -80; ls -a .lore"
/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '34,43p'; git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; git status -sb"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('## Measured semantics — out of scope','## Hook semantics').replace('chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts#L39','chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts#L38')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts
git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts
git commit -m 'test(orchestrator): pin turn usage totals' -m 'Relates to #93'
git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main --no-edit
git push origin HEAD
git status -sb"
